deployments_detail.use: GenAI in ~300 productions (2026) + longstanding ML recommendation engine + AI-generated ads; "all in" on GenAI

AI-assisted localization: Netflix uses AI to help translate, subtitle, dub and overdub content for international titles, accelerating its localization pipeline across many major languages; confirmed in its Q4 2025 shareholder letter. [In-house / third-party AI localization tools]

Metaflow, the ML/AI development framework created and open-sourced by Netflix, powers hundreds of production ML and AI systems and projects across Netflix engineering teams (recommendations, content, etc.). [In-house (Netflix), open-sourced]
deployments_detail.value: Powers hundreds of ML/AI projects across Netflix

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI advertising: the Netflix Ads Suite includes a modular ad-format framework that uses generative AI to blend advertisers' creative into the worlds of Netflix shows, including interactive midroll and pause formats and custom ads based on Netflix IP. [In-house (Netflix Ads Suite)]

Machine learning to create promotional media - generating and assembling trailers, previews and promotional artwork/imagery from source content to speed creative production and personalization. [In-house (Netflix)]

First generative-AI final footage in a Netflix original: a collapsing-building VFX sequence in the series 'The Eternaut' was produced with AI-powered VFX tools by Netflix's Eyeline Studios, and Netflix has begun using Runway AI's Gen-4 video-generation tools in production to accelerate VFX. [Netflix Eyeline Studios; Runway AI (Gen-4)]
deployments_detail.value: VFX sequence completed 10x faster than traditional VFX workflows

deployments_detail.use: Conversational, generative-AI powered search that lets members find titles using natural-language, mood and theme descriptions rather than title/genre lookups; rolled out in beta on the Netflix app. [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

A unified transformer-based foundation model for personalized recommendations that consolidates Netflix's many specialized recommender models to power homepage title ranking and personalization. [In-house (Netflix)]

VMAF (Video Multi-Method Assessment Fusion), a machine-learning perceptual video-quality metric that combines human vision modeling with ML, used across Netflix's encoding pipeline to optimize per-title/per-scene bitrate and video quality at scale. [In-house (Netflix), open-sourced]

INKubator, a new 'gen-AI native' internal animation studio Netflix established to produce short-form animated content using generative AI, with hiring across multiple gen-AI roles. [In-house (Netflix INKubator)]

Machine-learning fraud and abuse detection framework that models user streaming behavior with heuristic-aware ML models to detect account sharing abuse, credential/account fraud and other suspicious activity in the streaming service. [In-house (Netflix)]
